question: Queue item 20261030-1251-expand-dev-services-c696-u04-q01: does a WorkOS production environment provisioned through Stripe Projects (stripe projects add workos/auth, production configuration) still need a payment method added in the WorkOS Dashboard? Stripe states that a payment method is added to Stripe once, handed to the provider as a Shared Payment Token when a paid plan is selected, and required before any paid plan tier is provisioned. WorkOS states that production environments require active billing on the team and that selecting the production configuration is the same flow as sandbox. No first-party page says which payment method a production configuration provisioned through Stripe Projects uses. A third-party copy of the Stripe Projects catalog (docs.rs/stackless-integrations, providers/workos/auth.rs.html) lists workos/auth with pricing type paid and an environment setting of sandbox or production, with the free tier keyed to sandbox.
why: Settling it needs a Stripe account with a payment method and a WorkOS team: run the production configuration, then read the billing page of the WorkOS Dashboard. That needs an account and a payment method, so the step belongs to the operator.
